bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fairness by measuring the performance GAP (the average difference in True Positive Rate and True Negative Rate, representing equalised odds) between black and white demographic groups on a tweet sentiment/emoji prediction task.

Evaluating fairness by measuring the performance GAP (the average difference in True Positive Rate and True Negative Rate) between male and female subjects in an occupation classification task (surgeon vs. nurse) using short biographies.
